notes.title: Game Update Build 80.1 New Profile Manager, game fixes, patches
notes.notes:
[h3]Log - 4/13/21[/h3]

[i]Build Version 80.1[/i]

[h2][b]Game Patch Notes: [/b][/h2]
Players can now create their own profiles. The game no longer relies on one save file and one name at a time saved to the leaderboards. You can now login, logout, create or delete profiles. This allows for players to pick and choose names that are already listed, Each profile can be affected by cheats, although cheats activated will disable any achievements that are obtainable. The profile with used cheats will be flagged as "Cheats Active" other profiles can gain a completion percentage which is viewable by mouse hovering or selecting a profile in the manager. Each player will have their own respective settings and unlocks. The leaderboards and survival stats are now game based and not profile based, so each profile will contribute to them.

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*]Steam cloud didn't work, which is now working.
[*]Ship camera on game start randomly stuck at zero coordinates.
[*]Survival stats max multiplier from resetting back to 0 on death.
[*]Fixed Issues with game saves with the new profile manager.
[*]Music in survival mode resetting to level 1 after pausing.
[*]Issue with retro mode not unlocking, wrong object was activated.
[*]Adjusted and changed some UI elements and adjusted screen transitioning.
[/list]

[b][Changes][/b]
[list]
[*] New Game Profile System: individuals can now login into their own respective accounts (up to 10), delete or create new ones. which is stored in a database locally in game.
[*]Keyboard “P” and “Backspace” are no longer mapped to pause or Back. 
[*]Keyboard “return” now pauses the game.
[*]Added an Anti-achievement/Cheat system for profiles and cheat codes. 
[*]Turbo mode no longer activated with Gamepad “A” and replaced with “L3”.
[*]Profile system now processes old local game save into a profile.
[*]Game Profiles are assigned to their Steam ID.
[*]Default Option settings are now set to low quality.
[*]Main menu ship model, cursor and options icon now represents color of profile slot.
[/list]

[b][Known Bugs][/b]
[list]
[*]In game achievements are separated by their own profiles, but all profiles contribute to the main Steam achievements.
[*]Multiplier sometimes doesn't change to RGB when over 300.
[*]Steam Overlay can sometimes cause a possible game lockup which causes the application to close. [Seems to lock up only when broadcasting is active.]
[*]Megabyte's saber beam state glitches randomly, plays beam sound every frame, will not fire beam and will continue to charge forever. (unable to replicate it)
[*]Giga blaster takes a bit of performance due to the manipulating the material color to RGB with over 400 active bullets.
[*]Look rotation is extreme with v-sync off on high performance PC's.
Menu transitions are very fast with v-sync off.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update Build 79.0
notes.notes:
[h3]Log - 3/21/21[/h3]

[i]Build Version 79.0[/i]

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*]Compatibility with V-Sync off, high end systems with high frame rate caused pieces of the game to not smooth out properly. Look sensitivity with v-sync off & smoothing off will cause a very fast look rotation, turning on smoothing fixes this issue.
[*]Fixed while in upgrade menu, accessing options sub menus and backing out caused the button event selector to choose the upgrade menu "Continue" button leaving options open and no selection to it.
[*]Fixed plasma cannon weapon selection when enigma cannon was equipped. This caused the plasma cannon weapon model to select the "machine gun" and enigma cannon remained active, after the plasma weapon was unequipped the enigma cannon remained as the only weapon you could use.
[*]Fixed when player released the trigger the enigma cannon overclock bar would not drain, resulting in the player to over heat and take damage.
[*]Fixed issue with enigma cannon overclock UI bar remaining active when plasma cannon obtained.
[*]Fixed issue with fusion cannon discharge sound when letting go of the trigger if another weapon other than fusion was selected.
[*]Fixed issue with final MonoIcose boss. When EMP stunned while in beam state, the saber blazer beams remained active until next beam state, after the boss was no longer stunned.
[*]Made bosses appear quicker when entering battle scene. Bosses took at least 2/3 seconds longer to spawn in a bare space.
[*]Enlarged ammo and energy bars in game UI. energy & ammo bars were thin and barely noticeable which both play an important visual in game play.
[*]Added an infinity symbol to ammo amount when cyber, hyper or absorb abilities are active. Player can now know they have infinite missiles in an active ability.
[*]Fixed issue with rail upgrade 4 purchase price was set as rail upgrade 3.
[*]Fixed spread weapon rotation attachment icon, was set as the wrong icon on game screen.
[*]Fixed issue with homing missile and terminus missile purchase sound not activating when buying either.
[*]Widened Level 5's design. Enemies spawned into the side walls. 
[*]Added the "warp in effect" when reaching the portal after beating a boss.
[*]Smoothed the "warp out effect" when entering a level.
[*]Reduced camera shaking by half. Camera shaking caused an unstable jitter to player ship view.
[*]Changed the warp portal material image.
[*]Removed scrolling textures in level 7 & 8 to reduce frame rate reduction. A large amount of objects had scrolling textures.
[/list]
[b][Known Bugs][/b]

[list]
[*]Multiplier sometimes doesn't change to RGB when over 300.
[*]Steam Overlay can sometimes cause a possible game lockup which causes the application to close. [Seems to lock up only when broadcasting is active.]
[*]Megabyte's saber beam state glitches randomly, plays beam sound every frame, will not fire beam and will continue to charge forever. (unable to replicate it)
[*]Giga blaster takes a bit of performance due to the manipulating the material color to RGB with over 400 active bullets.
[*]Look rotation is extreme with v-sync off on high performance PC's.
[*]Menu transitions are very fast with v-sync off.
[/list]

notes.title: Build Version 78 - New Continue Feature, game play updates
notes.notes:
Log - 1/29/21

Build Version 78.2

[Bug Fixes]

Major Gameplay Update - Added Continue Function, Depending on difficulty, when a player has lost all lives, an option to continue will appear allowing the player to restart the current level instead of restarting the entire game.

Trainee Difficulty = 3 continues
Mayhem Difficulty = 2 continues
Chaos Difficulty = 1 continues
Nightmare Difficulty = 0 continues

[list]
[*]Issue on game continue on final boss, would still be active in coroutine and firing but "invisible".
[*]Changed the enemy position closer to the player so they are not so far way.
[*]Added a range cap on enemies that move towards player on level 12, enemies will stop when they are close enough instead of running into the player.
[*]Enemies chase the player down more quickly in level 12.
[*]Increased the look sensitivity values by 0.5 and expanded the max range from 5 to 10.
[*]Re-transcoded all videos, some where missing settings, Changed to Deinterlaced mode to "Even" this insures game videos are NTSC 1080P.
[*]Fixed issue where missiles would fail to set lock on reticle and lock notification.

[/list]

[Changes]
[list]
[*]Added an adjustment value to the scroll bars in the options menu, controller sensitivity shows current values instead of 0-100 as well as master, music, sound, UI and announcer bars.
[*]Added different Shield and Core colors when using enigma cannon, cyber realm, core absorb, plasma cannon instead of just invincibility. The shows how the ship impact reacts differently to enemy bullets.
[*]Added Explosions to the devastator and Enigma Cannons projectiles.
(induces heavier damage and radius damage).
[*]Added sparks to the ship when enemy projectile hits it.
[/list]

[Known Bugs]
[list]
[*]Multiplier sometimes doesn't change to RGB when over 300.
[*]Steam Overlay can sometimes cause a possible game lockup which causes the application to close. [Seems to lock up only when broadcasting is active.]
[*]Megabyte's saber beam state glitches randomly, plays beam sound every frame, will not fire beam and will continue to charge forever. (unable to replicate it)
[/list]

***UPDATES

[list]
[*]Fixed Issue with Level 12 background not resetting when continuing.
[*]Changed position of continue panel and updated some UI elements.
[*]Fixed issue with continuing on survival mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Build Version 77 - Mouse + keyboard game play fix and game patches
notes.notes:
Log - 1/21/21

Build Version 77

[Bug Fixes]
[olist]
[*]Major Gameplay Update - [Mouse movement] mouse movement was jittery as well as hyper sensitive. Player had lack of control during normal game play. mouse movement system for Level 12 [Free Ranged Mode] was changed. Camera rotates towards direction player is facing and re-adjusts to the center of aim, this give a more 3D space movement simulation as well as the added smoothing for better quality aim. Player can now move the camera while locked on to an enemy to adjust field of view.
[*]Both [Alt] Keys are buttons for Turbo now [Free Ranged Mode Only]
[*][Space] Key for turbo was removed due to interference with dashing.
[*]Locking on or activating absorb ability will stop the ship from moving forward even when turbo is active giving the player some control to dodge/absorb projectiles [Free Ranged Mode]. 
[*]Fixed emp bomb not working in survival.
[*]Fixed spreader rotator attachment not working in survival.
[*]Fixed super multiplier status still active after combo lost.
[*]Fixed the Rainbow Color Concept to unlock fully when reaching wave 120 (no longer need to buy it in arcade mode)
[*]Fixed skybox background missing after videos played. 
[*]Fixed skybox video not playing.
[*]Fixed issued where controller connected events wouldn't fire in upgrade menu.
[*]Fixed issue with Hellabyte, Gegobyte and bronto byte moving way too fast on nightmare.
[*]Fixed issue with Missile Reticle still active on screen when missile was pointed off screen.
[*]Fixed issue where missile reticle was still active when the player died or quit.
[*]Fixed issue where game wouldn't load save file until main menu was active.
[*]Fixed issue where game wouldn't detect if mouse & Keyboard was active until after the intro was finished.
[*]Fixed UI issue in booster menu where Y button was still active when mouse and keyboard was active.
[*]Fixed issue with Cyto missile projectiles being active after dying.
[*]Fixed issue with Devastator projectiles being active after dying.
[/olist]

[Changes]
[olist]
[*]Updated Keyboard & controller tutorial videos.
[*]Updated about tutorial.
[*]Re-adjusted the default sensitivity.
[*]Reduced the rotational field of view angles from 30 to 20.
[*]Adjusted over active sensitivity (cut sensitivity by half).

[/olist]
